# fjordrun_vpc_members (Data Source)

The environments of a private network, with their services and project-qualified hostnames.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "vpc_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_vpc_members" "backend" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  vpc_id  = var.vpc_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Team ID.
- `vpc_id` (String) Private network ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `members` (Attributes List) The members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
